runtime_authorization: This preparation does not authorize execution. Parent must commit the registration and separately dispatch one real calibration phase. The proposed run directory remains absent until that dispatch.

custodian_freeze_verification.oracle_and_selection_integrity: Custodian byte/hash verification only. Driver must not open those files or follow paths inside freezes.

actor_workspace_contract.workspace_names: Exact family IDs; workspace and user UUIDs are assigned only by future registration responses.
actor_workspace_contract.membership: actor2 joins actor1 workspace as in the fixed browser code; actor1 is not a member of actor2 workspace.
actor_workspace_contract.visibility_rule: General document private; both meeting documents workspace, identically for both families. Chosen by document kind, without question or oracle selection.
actor_workspace_contract.answer_principal: Each family owner, with access to all three whole family documents.

source_mapping_contract.old_ids: Prepared IDs are taken from the accepted real Java document readbacks; the future run must generate distinct document and chunk IDs and record the mapping.
source_mapping_contract.source_revision: Public upstream immutable commit; synthetic immutable accepted content SHA-256. Prepared service revision1 is recorded separately.
source_mapping_contract.prior_java_scope: Ordinary /documents ingestion and full chunk verification only; prior source preparation did not validate meeting registration or autoanalysis.

existing_policy_scope: Use the registered launcher/default factories and their exact CI-bound policies. No endpoint, model, context, retrieval, tokenizer, repair, translation, warmup or fallback override.

single_use_contract.analysis_native_attempts: Separately counted under the existing multi-unit extraction policy; not asserted as one native call per API operation.
single_use_contract.resource_or_integrity_failure: Stop phase at first failure and retain later cases as unexecuted.
single_use_contract.semantic_judgment: Separate registered final judge after shutdown; executor does not score or tune responses.
